reasons.text: About 31% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -34 bu/ac in 2011 to about +1 bu/ac in 2009.
